Name: Continuous Music
Author: exhaustors
Description:
This mod allows the music from the vanilla game to play more frequently.

[size=4][b]Details[/b][/size]
[list=1]
[*]The music cuts off when it gets dark outside, and there is no music on rainy days.
[*]The seasonal theme will cycle randomly between all three themes on a given day.
[*]Both the seasonal and town music will play continuously indoors if there is no location-specific music (e.g. inside the farm house). If the player  enters town while the seasonal theme is playing, the town music will start once the seasonal theme has finished, given the player is still in town at that time.
[*]If the player is indoors on Ginger Island (without location-specific music, i.e. inside the island farm house or the shipwreck) when the island theme stops playing, the music will not resume until the player is outside
[/list]
[size=4][b]Install[/b]
[/size][list=1]
[*]Install the latest version of [url=https://smapi.io/]SMAPI[/url]﻿.
[*]Unzip the mod folder into Stardew Valley/Mods.
[*]Run the game using SMAPI.
[/list]
[size=4][b]Compatibility
[/b][/size][list=1]
[*]Only compatible with Stardew Valley 1.6.

[*]Should be compatible with Linux, MacOS, and Windows.[size=2]
[/size]
[/list]
